messages:
Lina: seeing a spike of 503s from proxy-eu-1 for the last 3m, errors up to ~12% on the dashboard :grimacing:
Amar: ugh. which deploys are in the pipeline right now?
Lina: several canaries rolling, next slot is slot-347 (canary rev 2026.03.21-01)
deploybot: [AUTO] Detected error-rate spike (proxy-eu-1) > threshold. Pausing queued deployments and engaging gate. Action: pause all non-critical rollouts. Reason: proxy-503-threshold.
Marta: ops-oncall can you confirm customer impact?
ops-oncall: confirmed — ingress cluster in eu-1 is returning 503s due to connection churn with backend pool after a scaling event. SLO alerts at P50/95. ETA mitigation 25-40m. Recommend holding all scheduled releases for at least 1h.
ReleaseManager: OK — pin current canary, cancel/hold any releases targeting eu-1 change windows between 02:00-04:00 UTC. We'll re-evaluate at 03:00 UTC.
Amar: we had a hotfix scheduled for 02:30 — can we route that to hotpatch lane (us-east only) and proceed?
Lina: hotpatch allowed only if the release bypasses eu-1 entirely (dedicated pool/us-east) and we have QA signoff. Otherwise hold.
deploybot: NOTE: paused deployments: slot-347, slot-348, slot-349, slot-350. To request an override, react with :override: and obtain approval from at least two SREs.
Marta: i'm +1 for an override if the hotfix targets us-east and QA+SRE signoffs are present.
ops-oncall: we can route around eu-1 by 02:10 if you start canary in us-east and short-circuit region routing. Will need rollback toggle ready.
ReleaseManager: quick checklist to allow hotpatch override — add to release notes channel: 1) QA green on us-east canary, 2) two SRE approvals, 3) region-override flag set, 4) post-deploy smoke tests pass.
Lina: adding recent logs — snippet from proxy-eu-1: ```
$ kubectl logs -n proxy proxy-eu-1-9c8f | tail -n 30
2026-03-21T01:12:45Z ERROR upstream timeout
2026-03-21T01:12:46Z ERROR 503 write failed
2026-03-21T01:12:46Z WARN conn-reset by backend
```
Amar: i'll prep the patch and ping SREs. Triage: will try canary in us-east and follow the checklist.
deploybot: Scheduled automated resume check at 6598765832 (in 400s).
Marta: adding to ops runbook: if resumed check fails at 03:00, extend hold +60m and notify customers via status page. :loudspeaker:
ReleaseManager: thanks — keep this thread updated with QA/SRE approvals and any rollback triggers.
